vendor/three.min.js, OrbitControls.js, Simulation.js and shaders.js are
copied from spite/polygon-shredder (MIT). Do not edit them to "improve"
the look; run vendor.mjs when moving the pin.

package: spite/polygon-shredder
url:     https://github.com/spite/polygon-shredder
commit:  41162311223fcb6862d33a40dd21e8eeca4c74f5 (master)
entry:   js/main-boxels.js + js/Simulation.js + shaders in index.html
         + js/three.min.js (three.js r73-era, as shipped)

COPYING-polygon-shredder.txt  MIT, Copyright (c) 2016 Jaume Sanchez
COPYING-three.txt             MIT, three.js authors

Curl noise GLSL is from Isaac Cohen / Ashima Arts (MIT), already in the
simulation fragment shader.

spotlight.jpg is NOT packed. vendor/shredder.js draws a radial gradient
instead so the sandbox never fetches a texture.

Facebook / Twitter / Google+ widgets, dat.gui, FBOHelper and the Google
font are dropped. Settings live in the file. Press Invite for a shared shred.
